keyPointsEn: Loop architecture: LLM proposes strict JSON proposals, no model-written code; evaluation on discovery, validation, and one-time holdout, with results recorded in a hash-chained ledger.

Admission criteria: Acceptance requires multiple absolute gates (positive edge, net P&L after costs, bootstrap lower bound, survival at elevated costs, per-year stability, and sample floors), not a single score.

Empirical results: Across multiple campaigns (e.g., 0DTE options, overnight SPX verticals), most hypotheses fail, only two pass pre-registered bars; one LLM survivor's Sharpe dropped from ~3 to 0.26 on holdout.
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a bounded LLM research loop for quantitative finance with strict evaluation and admission to prevent overfitting, tested across multiple asset classes, finding most hypotheses fail and only a few pass pre-registered criteria.
cards.titleEn: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
keyPoints: 循环架构：LLM提出严格JSON提案，无模型编写代码；评估在发现、验证和一次性留出集上进行，结果记录在哈希链账本中。
准入标准：接受需满足多个绝对门控（正边际、成本后净盈亏、bootstrap下界、高成本存活、年度稳定性和样本下限），而非单一分数。
实证结果：在多个campaign（如0DTE期权、隔夜SPX垂直价差等）中，大多数假设失败，仅两个通过预注册标准；一个LLM幸存者在留出集上夏普从约3降至0.26。
cards.summaryEn: The study designs an autonomous quantitative research loop where an LLM only proposes declarative JSON proposals, and trusted code executes backtests and evaluation. Evaluation uses immutable data stores split into discovery, validation, and a one-time final holdout, with acceptance based on multiple absolute gates (e.g., net P&L after costs, bootstrap lower bound). Across multiple campaigns, most hypotheses fail, and only two pass pre-registered bars; the clearest example is an LLM survivor with Sharpe near 3 on discovery and validation that fell to 0.26 on its single holdout use.
cards.limitationsEn: The study only reports campaigns run by the authors and does not cover other markets or strategies; the two results passing pre-registered bars still require independent validation; the loop's effectiveness depends on the design of gate criteria and data splits, and unconsidered biases may exist.
cards.summary: 该研究设计了一个自主量化研究循环，其中LLM仅提出声明式JSON提案，由可信代码执行回测和评估。评估使用不可变数据存储，分为发现、验证和一次性最终留出集，并通过多重绝对门控（如成本后净盈亏、bootstrap下界等）决定是否接受。在已运行的多个 campaign 中，大多数假设失败，仅两个通过预注册标准；最清晰的示例是一个在发现和验证集上夏普接近3的策略在最终留出集上降至0.26。
cards.whyItMatters: 该循环的价值在于其难以让模型报告不存在的发现，从而减少量化研究中常见的虚假发现（如过拟合、前视偏差、多重比较等），为自动化研究提供了一种更严谨的框架。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The value of such a loop lies in how hard it is to make it report something that is not there, reducing false discoveries (e.g., overfitting, look-ahead, multiple comparisons) common in quantitative research and offering a more rigorous framework for automated research.
cards.description: 提出一种在量化金融中约束LLM研究循环的方法，通过严格评估和准入机制防止过拟合，并在多个资产类别中测试，发现大多数假设失败，仅少数通过预注册标准。
cards.limitations: 研究仅报告了作者已运行的campaign，未涉及其他市场或策略；通过预注册标准的两个结果仍需独立验证；循环的有效性依赖于门控标准和数据划分的设计，可能存在未考虑的偏差。
cards.originalTitle: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
cards.title: 有界LLM研究循环：量化金融中多数假设失败，少数幸存

keyPointsEn: The benchmark contains 1,200 multi-agent cooking-scenario questions, with answers determined by execution and exact search.
The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy and is near chance on optimality verification.
Paired variants reveal that some models report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already supplied.
cards.descriptionEn: The work introduces a benchmark of 1,200 multi-agent cooking-scenario questions, with reference answers established via execution and exact search; models must select an optimal team plan and judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. Its novelty lies in paired variants that separate selecting a good plan from judging whether the options already contain an optimal one, exposing systematic errors hidden by accuracy alone.
cards.titleEn: TandemBench: A Multi-Agent Collaboration Decision Benchmark Exposing Optimality-Judgment Gaps
keyPoints: 基准包含1200道多智能体烹饪场景问题，答案由执行与精确搜索确定。
最佳原生决策模型决策准确率为62.50%，最优性验证接近随机。
配对变体揭示部分模型不论是否已含最优计划都报告存在更好替代。
cards.summaryEn: TandemBench gives models complete global information and candidate team plans, asking them to pick an optimal plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove the optimal plan, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the given options. The authors report that the best native decision model reaches 62.50% decision accuracy, while native decision models remain close to chance on optimality verification. Paired tests show some models claim better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present, indicating that decision accuracy alone can conceal judgment errors.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from multi-agent cooking scenarios and pre-supplied team-plan options, so findings may not generalize to other collaboration tasks or open action spaces. The evaluation covers 40 native decision models and 10 general-purpose language models; near-chance optimality verification and paired-test behaviors should be interpreted in light of specific models and prompting setups, and should not be used to infer real-world deployment performance.
cards.summary: TandemBench 让模型在完整全局信息下从候选团队计划中选择最优方案，并在保留或移除最优计划的配对变体中判断是否还有更优安排。作者报告最佳原生决策模型决策准确率为62.50%，而原生决策模型在最优性验证上接近随机水平。配对测试显示部分模型无论是否已给最优计划都会声称存在更好替代，说明仅看决策准确率会掩盖判定错误。
cards.whyItMatters: 在多智能体协作中，决策涉及分工、资源交换与并行行动；仅衡量能否选出给定方案中的最优项，可能无法反映模型是否真正理解选项集合是否已最优，该基准为此提供了可诊断的评测方式。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In multi-agent collaboration, decisions involve work division, resource exchange, and parallel action; measuring only whether a model picks the best among given options may not reflect whether it understands that the option set is already optimal, and this benchmark offers a diagnostic evaluation for that gap.
cards.description: 该工作提出包含1200道多智能体烹饪场景问题的基准，用执行与精确搜索建立参考答案，并要求模型在给定团队方案中选优及判断是否存在更优安排。其新意在于用配对变体区分“选对方案”与“判断选项是否已含最优”，从而暴露准确率掩盖的系统性错误。
cards.limitations: 证据来自多智能体烹饪场景与预先给定的团队方案选项，结论未必可外推到其他协作任务或开放行动空间；评测对象为40个原生决策模型与10个通用语言模型，最优性验证接近随机及配对测试中的行为模式需结合具体模型与提示设置理解，不宜据此推断实际部署表现。
cards.originalTitle: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration
cards.title: TandemBench：多智能体协作决策基准揭示判定盲区

keyPointsEn: When2Tool covers three categories of tool necessity—computational scale, knowledge boundaries, and execution reliability—with controlled difficulty levels creating clear decision boundaries.

Existing training-free baselines (prompt-only and reason-then-act) provide limited control: the former suppresses necessary calls, while the latter incurs disproportionate accuracy costs on hard tasks.
Probe&Prefill uses a lightweight linear probe to read hidden-state signals and prefill a steering sentence, reducing tool calls by 38% with only 1.7% accuracy loss across six models.
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces the When2Tool benchmark to systematically evaluate tool necessity decisions in LLM agents, finds that tool necessity is linearly decodable from hidden states, and designs Probe&Prefill to reduce unnecessary tool calls.
cards.titleEn: LLM Agents Already Know When to Call Tools
keyPoints: When2Tool基准覆盖计算规模、知识边界和执行可靠性三类工具必要性，并设置可控难度以形成清晰决策边界。
现有免训练基线（仅提示和先推理后行动）控制效果有限：前者误抑制必要调用，后者在困难任务上准确率代价过高。
Probe&Prefill利用轻量线性探针读取隐藏状态信号并预填引导句，在六个模型上实现工具调用减少38%而准确率仅降1.7%。
cards.summaryEn: The research builds the When2Tool benchmark with 18 environments to assess when agents truly need tools. The authors find that hidden states linearly decode tool necessity with AUROC 0.89-0.96, far exceeding the model's own verbalized reasoning. Based on this, Probe&Prefill reduces tool calls by 38% with only 1.7% accuracy loss.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on six tested models and 18 controlled environments; the linear decodability and generalization of Probe&Prefill have not been validated on broader model families, real open-ended scenarios, or dynamic tool sets. The probe requires per-model training, and the benchmark difficulty levels may not fully capture the ambiguity of real-world tasks.
cards.summary: 研究构建了涵盖18个环境的When2Tool基准，用于评估智能体何时真正需要调用工具。作者发现模型隐藏状态能以AUROC 0.89-0.96线性解码工具必要性，远超模型自身语言化推理的表现。基于此提出的Probe&Prefill方法将工具调用减少38%，准确率仅损失1.7%。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作揭示了LLM智能体在生成前已编码工具必要性信息，为降低不必要工具调用带来的API费用与延迟提供了无需额外训练的新思路，并建立了系统评估工具调用必要性的基准。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work reveals that LLM agents already encode tool necessity before generation, offering a training-free approach to reduce API costs and latency from unnecessary tool calls, and establishes a benchmark for systematically evaluating tool call necessity.
cards.description: 该研究提出When2Tool基准，系统评估LLM智能体在工具必要性上的决策，发现模型隐藏状态可线性解码工具需求，并据此设计Probe&Prefill方法以减少不必要调用。
cards.limitations: 结论基于所测试的六个模型和18个受控环境，线性可解码性及Probe&Prefill的泛化性尚未在更广泛模型家族、真实开放场景或动态工具集上验证；探针需针对每个模型单独训练，且基准难度分级可能无法完全反映现实任务的模糊性。
cards.originalTitle: LLM Agents Already Know When to Call Tools -- Even Without Reasoning
cards.title: 大模型智能体已知何时该调用工具

keyPointsEn: The constraint set is a general non-empty closed convex set, covering no short-selling, no borrowing, and portfolio-mix constraints
A reparameterized neural network method computes lower and upper bounds on the primal value function via artificial markets and Lagrangian duality
With U.S. calibration the duality gap is smaller than benchmarks, and constrained versus unconstrained solutions differ in wealth, portfolios, and insurance demand
cards.descriptionEn: The study addresses defined-contribution pension management with general convex trading constraints in a two-factor market model and proposes a reparameterized neural network method to compute lower and upper bounds on the primal value function, with U.S.-calibrated experiments showing a smaller duality gap than benchmarks.
cards.titleEn: Constrained DC Pension Management Solved by a Reparameterized Neural Network
keyPoints: 约束集为一般非空闭凸集，禁卖空、禁借贷和组合比例限制均为其特例
提出重参数化神经网络方法，通过无约束人工市场与拉格朗日对偶计算原值函数上下界
美国数据校准下对偶间隙小于基准方法，且约束与无约束解在财富积累、组合与保险需求上差异明显
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies defined-contribution pension management in a two-factor market where the participant can invest in cash, two nominal bonds, an inflation-linked bond, and a stock index, and can buy term life insurance, subject to a general non-empty closed convex trading constraint set that includes no short-selling, no borrowing, and portfolio-mix limits as special cases. The authors construct unconstrained artificial markets, derive a Lagrangian dual problem, and propose a reparameterized neural network method to compute lower and upper bounds on the primal value function; with U.S. data calibrated by a Kalman filter, the method yields a smaller duality gap than benchmark methods. The authors report that constrained and unconstrained explicit solutions differ substantially in wealth accumulation, portfolio strategies, and insurance demand, and argue that unconstrained solutions may mislead practice, which is their interpretation of the numerical results.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rest on the authors' two-factor market model, specific constraint set, and U.S.-calibrated numerical experiments and do not guarantee general validity for real pension products; a smaller duality gap only indicates better accuracy than benchmarks in their setting and does not prove the constrained solution is truly optimal; the paper does not provide an analytical characterization of the gap between constrained and unconstrained solutions, and practical use requires recalibration and testing of model assumptions.
cards.summary: 论文研究双因子市场下可投资现金、两类名义债券、通胀挂钩债券与股票指数，并可购买定期寿险的DC养老金管理问题，约束为一般非空闭凸交易约束集，涵盖禁卖空、禁借贷与组合比例限制。作者构造一族无约束人工市场并以对偶变换导出拉格朗日对偶问题，提出重参数化神经网络方法计算原值函数的上下界；用美国数据经卡尔曼滤波校准后，其方法对偶间隙小于基准方法。作者指出约束解与无约束显式解在财富积累、组合策略与保险需求上差异显著，认为无约束解可能对实践产生误导，这属于作者基于其数值实验的判断。
cards.whyItMatters: 养老金账户常受卖空、借贷和组合比例等交易限制，若直接采用无约束最优解可能高估可行收益并给出偏离实践的配置与保险建议；该文提供可处理一般凸约束的数值求解框架，并用对偶间隙衡量解的精度，对约束下养老金决策研究有方法参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Pension accounts commonly face short-selling, borrowing, and portfolio-mix limits, so using unconstrained optima directly may overstate feasible outcomes and give guidance that departs from practice; the paper offers a numerical framework for general convex constraints and uses the duality gap to gauge solution accuracy, which is methodologically useful for research on constrained pension decisions.
cards.description: 该研究在双因子市场模型中处理带一般凸交易约束的DC养老金管理，提出重参数化神经网络方法计算原问题值函数上下界，并用美国数据校准显示其原始-对偶间隙小于基准方法。
cards.limitations: 结论基于作者设定的双因子市场模型、特定约束集与美国数据校准的数值实验，不构成对真实养老金产品的普遍保证；对偶间隙更小仅说明该方法在其实验设定下精度优于基准，不证明约束解即为真实最优；文中未提供约束解相对无约束解偏差的解析刻画，实际应用需重新校准并检验模型假设。
cards.originalTitle: Constrained defined-contribution pension management: A reparameterized neural network approach
cards.title: 带交易约束的DC养老金管理：重参数化神经网络求解

keyPointsEn: Single forward pass surpasses tuned and ensembled baselines on TabArena and Pareto-dominates the speed/performance frontier
Supports up to 1M training rows and 200 features, and is up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5
Introduces test-time compute scaling: TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) claimed to lead non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo
Extends to relational data (RelBenchV1), tabular-text (TabSTAR) and time series (2nd on fev-bench)
cards.descriptionEn: This technical report claims TabPFN-3, pretrained only on synthetic data, beats tuned and ensembled baselines in a single forward pass on TabArena, extends usable scale to 1M training rows and 200 features, and cuts training and inference time substantially while adding test-time compute scaling (Plus/Thinking). Its value lies in advancing tabular foundation model performance, speed and scalability together, and extending them to relational, tabular-text and time-series tasks
cards.titleEn: TabPFN-3 Scales Tabular Foundation Models to One Million Rows and Adds Test-Time Compute Scaling
keyPoints: 单次前向在 TabArena 上超过调优与集成基线，并帕累托占优速度/性能前沿
支持至多 100 万训练行、200 个特征，比 TabPFN-2.5 快至多 20 倍
引入测试时算力扩展：TabPFN-3-Plus（Thinking）称领先非 TabPFN 模型超 200 Elo
扩展至关系数据（RelBenchV1）、表格-文本（TabSTAR）与时间序列（fev-bench 第 2）
cards.summaryEn: The report states that TabPFN-3 is pretrained exclusively on synthetic data from the authors' prior and, in a single forward pass on TabArena, outperforms all compared models while Pareto-dominating the speed/performance frontier. The authors report a reduced KV cache and row-chunking enable fast inference up to 1M rows on a single H100, and that the model is up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5. They further introduce test-time compute scaling via TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking), claimed to lead non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo on TabArena while being about 10x faster than AutoGluon 1.5 extreme. All of these are author-reported results that require independent replication.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rest mainly on the authors' own TabArena and selected benchmarks; Elo margins and speedups are measured by the reporting party and lack independent third-party replication; the 1M-row and 200-feature limits constrain very large-scale settings; test-time compute scaling raises inference cost, so gains must be weighed per task; and the out-of-distribution generalization boundary of synthetic-data pretraining is not fully characterized in the report.
cards.summary: 报告称 TabPFN-3 仅用先验生成的合成数据预训练，在 TabArena 上单次前向即优于所有对比模型，并在速度-性能前沿上帕累托占优。作者表示其通过小 KV 缓存与行分块在单张 H100 上支持 100 万行快速推理，比 TabPFN-2.5 快至多 20 倍。作者进一步提出测试时算力扩展的 TabPFN-3-Plus（Thinking），称其在 TabArena 上领先非 TabPFN 模型 200 Elo 以上，且快于 AutoGluon 1.5 extreme 约 10 倍。上述均为作者自述结论，需独立复现验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果成立，表格预测可在不依赖真实数据与大型 LLM 的情况下，以更快速度接近或超过重度调优的梯度提升树与 AutoML 方案，对科学和工业中大量中小规模表格任务具有直接工程意义。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the results hold, tabular prediction could approach or exceed heavily tuned gradient-boosted trees and AutoML without real data or large LLMs, at higher speed, which is directly relevant to the many small-to-medium tabular tasks in science and industry.
cards.description: 该技术报告宣称 TabPFN-3 仅用合成数据预训练，即在 TabArena 基准单次前向中超过调优与集成基线，并将可用规模扩展到 100 万训练行、200 个特征，同时显著降低训练与推理时间，还新增测试时算力扩展（Plus/Thinking 版本）。其价值在于把表格基础模型的性能、速度与可扩展性同时推进，并延伸到关系数据、表格-文本和时间序列任务。
cards.limitations: 结论主要来自作者自建的 TabArena 及选定基准，Elo 与加速倍数均为报告方测量，缺少独立第三方复现；100 万行上限与 200 特征的条件限制了超大规模场景；测试时算力扩展会提高推理成本，其收益需按任务核算；合成数据预训练带来的分布外泛化边界未在报告中充分界定。
cards.title: TabPFN-3 将表格基础模型扩展至百万行并引入测试时算力扩展

keyPointsEn: Proposes a CNN+MLP direct mapping estimator from high-frequency to low-frequency skewness, reducing finite-sample bias.
Monte Carlo experiments with jump stochastic volatility models confirm accuracy under model misspecification.
Empirical results show temporal stability and cross-sectional performance in skewness-sorted portfolios, with risk consistency theory.
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a new estimator of monthly low-frequency skewness that uses 5-minute high-frequency data through a direct functional mapping of convolutional neural networks followed by multi-layer perceptrons. The novelty lies in replacing traditional moment-based estimators with a neural network to reduce finite-sample bias; its usefulness is demonstrated by Monte Carlo and empirical results showing accuracy, temporal stability, and cross-sectional performance.
cards.titleEn: Convolutional Neural Network Estimation of Realized Skewness Reduces Finite-Sample Bias
keyPoints: 提出CNN+MLP直接映射的高频到低频偏度估计器，降低小样本偏差。
蒙特卡洛实验覆盖含跳跃的随机波动率模型，验证在模型误设下仍准确。
实证显示时间稳定性和偏度排序组合的横截面表现，并建立风险一致性理论。
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a realized skewness estimator based on convolutional neural networks and multi-layer perceptrons that maps 5-minute high-frequency data to monthly low-frequency skewness. Monte Carlo experiments with stochastic volatility models, with and without jumps, show that the estimator reduces finite-sample bias relative to existing realized-skewness estimators and remains accurate under model misspecification. Empirically, the estimator exhibits temporal stability and cross-sectional performance in skewness-sorted portfolios; the authors also characterize the finite-sample bias of conventional plug-in estimators and establish risk consistency of the proposed NN estimator.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes mainly from Monte Carlo simulations and specific empirical samples, not covering all market conditions; interpretability and robustness of the neural network estimator need further testing; risk consistency relies on standard regularity conditions; empirical results do not constitute investment advice.
cards.summary: 作者提出一种基于卷积神经网络和多层感知机的“已实现”偏度估计器，利用5分钟高频数据映射到月度低频偏度。蒙特卡洛实验（含跳跃的随机波动率模型）表明该估计器相比现有已实现偏度估计器降低了小样本偏差，且在模型误设下仍保持准确。实证中，该估计器表现出时间稳定性，并在实际偏度排序组合中展现横截面表现；作者还刻画了传统插入估计器的小样本偏差并建立所提神经网络估计器的风险一致性。
cards.whyItMatters: 为低频偏度估计提供数据驱动的高频信息利用方式，有助于改善小样本下的偏度度量精度，对风险管理和组合构建中的偏度排序有潜在应用价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a data-driven way to exploit high-frequency information for low-frequency skewness estimation, potentially improving skewness measurement accuracy in small samples, with implications for risk management and skewness-sorted portfolio construction.
cards.description: 该研究提出一种新方法，利用5分钟高频数据通过卷积神经网络与多层感知机直接映射，估计月度低频偏度。新意在于用神经网络替代传统矩估计以降低小样本偏差；有用之处在于蒙特卡洛与实证显示其准确性、时间稳定性及横截面表现。
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自蒙特卡洛模拟和特定实证样本，未涵盖所有市场条件；神经网络估计器的可解释性和稳健性需进一步检验；风险一致性依赖标准正则条件；实证结果不构成投资建议。
cards.originalTitle: Estimating "Realized" Skewness using Convolutional Neural Network
cards.title: 卷积神经网络估计已实现偏度：降低小样本偏差

keyPointsEn: Rebuilds Hyperliquid full-depth books from consensus-ordered messages and evaluates wallet identity as a feature
Notional-weighted 10-second markout rankings persist across adjacent 10-day windows (reported rho = 0.52)
Authors report wallet features raise one-second out-of-sample R2 from 10.88% to about 12 (figures per original)
cards.descriptionEn: The study reconstructs order books from Hyperliquid Level-4 messages and evaluates wallet identity as a feature for short-horizon return prediction. If wallet identity carries information, it could offer a quantitative signal beyond anonymous public order books.
cards.titleEn: Wallet Identity as a Feature Improves Short-Horizon Return Prediction
keyPoints: 用共识排序消息重建Hyperliquid全深度订单簿，并将钱包身份作为特征进行评估
相邻10天窗口中名义加权10秒markout排名具持续性（作者报告rho=0.52）
作者报告：钱包特征使1秒样本外R2从10.88%升至约12（原文数值需核对）
cards.summaryEn: Using Hyperliquid Level-4 records from July 1–27, 2026 (17.1 billion messages, 14.3 million aggressive orders by 147,113 wallets, and $84.3 billion in taker notional across ten markets), the authors reconstruct full-depth books and assess wallet identity as a short-horizon return predictor. They report that notional-weighted 10-second markout rankings persist across adjacent 10-day windows (Spearman rho = 0.52) and that covariate-adjusted validation markouts reach 3.11 basis points in the top ventile. On a 100-millisecond grid, eleven features describing previously scored top-decile wallets raise one-second out-of-sample R2 from 10.88% to 12, per the authors; these figures require checking against the full paper's methodology.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a single platform (Hyperliquid), a July 1–27, 2026 sample, and ten markets; extrapolation to other exchanges, assets, or periods is uncertain. R2 gains and markout values depend on model specification, time grid, and feature construction, and the input lacks full details on robustness, transaction costs, and rolling out-of-sample tests. Wallets are pseudonymous addresses whose persistence may decay with participant behavior and platform rule changes. This is a research abstract, not investment advice.
cards.summary: 研究基于2026年7月1日至27日的Hyperliquid Level-4记录，覆盖171亿条消息、147,113个钱包的1,430万笔主动订单及843亿美元taker名义金额，据此重建全深度订单簿并评估钱包身份作为短周期收益预测特征的价值。作者报告：在三个模型市场中，按名义金额加权的10秒markout排名在相邻10天窗口间持续（Spearman rho=0.52）；协变量调整后验证markout在最高十分位组达到3.11个基点。在100毫秒网格上，11个描述此前已评分的前十分位钱包的特征，将1秒样本外R2从10.88%提升至12。上述数字需在原文完整口径下核对，属于作者实证报告。
cards.whyItMatters: 如果钱包身份包含匿名订单簿之外的信息，短周期收益预测可利用更细粒度的参与者结构信号，为特征工程和微结构研究提供新方向。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If wallet identity contains information beyond anonymous order books, short-horizon return prediction may exploit finer-grained participant structure, informing feature engineering and microstructure research.
cards.description: 该研究利用Hyperliquid的Level-4消息记录重建订单簿，把交易者钱包身份纳入短周期收益预测特征，并检验其预测增量。若钱包身份具有信息价值，则可为公开匿名订单簿之外提供新的量化信号来源。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自Hyperliquid单一平台、2026年7月1日至27日的样本及十个市场，结论外推至其他交易所、资产或时期需谨慎。R2提升与markout数值依赖具体模型设定、时间网格和特征构造，未在输入中给出稳健性、交易成本与样本外滚动检验的完整细节；钱包为伪匿名地址，其持续性可能随参与者行为与平台规则变化而衰减。本文仅为研究摘要，不构成投资建议。
cards.originalTitle: Beyond Anonymous Order Flow: Wallet Identity as a Feature for Short-Horizon Return Prediction
cards.title: 钱包身份特征提升短周期收益预测能力

keyPointsEn: Nine recurring defect categories across stages are identified from 1,932 execution trajectories.
EMBERS generates stage-targeted test inputs via defect-guided mutation and web-search-assisted fidelity assurance.
Failure-discovery throughput is 3.21 times that of the strongest baseline across 16 framework-model-dataset settings.
cards.descriptionEn: The study analyzes 1,932 execution trajectories of deep research systems to identify nine recurring defect categories and proposes EMBERS, a defect-guided fuzzing framework that generates stage-targeted inputs via defect-guided mutation, achieving 3.21x the failure-discovery throughput of the strongest baseline under identical testing budgets while most generated inputs preserve the original information need.
cards.titleEn: EMBERS: Defect-Guided Fuzzing for Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems
keyPoints: 从1,932条执行轨迹中归纳出九类跨阶段的重复缺陷类别。
EMBERS通过缺陷引导变异和网络搜索辅助保真生成阶段针对性测试输入。
在16种框架-模型-数据集设置下，失败发现吞吐量为最强基线的3.21倍。
cards.summaryEn: The authors conduct an empirical study of 1,932 execution trajectories from three representative deep research systems and identify nine recurring defect categories across subquestion formulation, online search, and final reasoning. Guided by these findings, they propose EMBERS, a framework that uses defect-guided mutation, web-search-assisted fidelity assurance, and diversity-aware seed maintenance to generate test inputs. Experiments across 16 framework-model-dataset settings show EMBERS achieves 3.21 times the failure-discovery throughput of the strongest baseline, with human and LLM-assisted evaluations indicating most generated inputs preserve the original information need and necessary contextual constraints, and fine-tuning experiments showing consistent-answer performance improvement.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on 1,932 trajectories from three representative deep research systems, so the defect taxonomy and EMBERS effectiveness may be limited by the selected systems and datasets; although human and LLM-assisted evaluations show most inputs preserve the information need, not all generated inputs are guaranteed to satisfy constraints; the magnitude and generalizability of fine-tuning performance gains require further validation.
cards.summary: 作者对三个代表性深度研究系统的1,932条执行轨迹进行实证研究，识别出子问题表述、在线搜索和最终推理三个阶段共九类重复缺陷。基于这些发现，作者提出EMBERS框架，利用缺陷引导变异、网络搜索辅助保真和多样性感知种子维护生成测试输入。实验表明EMBERS在16种设置下失败发现吞吐量达最强基线的3.21倍，人类与LLM辅助评估显示多数生成输入保留原始信息需求和必要上下文约束，模型微调实验也显示一致答案性能提升。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将实证发现的缺陷模式转化为可操作的模糊测试策略，为深度研究系统的鲁棒性评估提供了系统化方法，并表明生成的测试输入可用于模型微调以提升一致答案性能。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work translates empirically identified defect patterns into actionable fuzzing strategies, providing a systematic method for robustness evaluation of deep research systems and showing that generated test inputs can be used for model fine-tuning to improve consistent-answer performance.
cards.description: 该研究通过分析1,932条深度研究系统执行轨迹，归纳出九类重复缺陷，并提出EMBERS模糊测试框架，以缺陷引导的变异生成阶段针对性输入，在相同测试预算下实现3.21倍于最强基线的失败发现吞吐量，且多数生成输入保留原始信息需求。
cards.limitations: 研究基于三个代表性深度研究系统的1,932条轨迹，缺陷分类和EMBERS的有效性可能受限于所选系统与数据集；人类与LLM辅助评估虽显示多数输入保留信息需求，但未保证所有生成输入均满足约束；微调实验的性能提升幅度和泛化性需进一步验证。
cards.originalTitle: EMBERS: Empirically Motivated Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems via Defect-Guided Fuzzing
cards.title: EMBERS：面向深度研究系统的缺陷引导模糊测试

keyPointsEn: Uses semantic ontology and knowledge graphs as a reasoning layer over data
Targets LLM and agent workflows, emphasizing deterministic query generation
Aims to improve context retrieval quality and result explainability
cards.descriptionEn: The framework builds a semantic, graph-based reasoning layer over data, offering deterministic query generation, improved context retrieval and stronger explainability for LLM and agent workflows; its novelty lies in using ontology and graph reasoning as a structured middleware layer, making retrieval and querying more controllable and traceable.
cards.titleEn: NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology Semantic Framework
keyPoints: 以语义本体和知识图谱作为数据之上的推理层
面向 LLM 与智能体工作流，强调确定性查询生成
目标包括提升上下文检索质量与结果可解释性
cards.summaryEn: NVIDIA's Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. According to its project description, it enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval and explainability for LLM and agent workflows. These claims come from the project itself and have not yet been independently benchmarked.
cards.limitationsEn: The available information is limited to a GitHub Trending entry and the project's own description, with no third-party evaluation, benchmark data or production case studies; the framework's actual query accuracy, explainability gains, scalability and integration costs remain unverified, so its effectiveness in specific business contexts should not be inferred from this material.
cards.summary: NVIDIA 的 Auto Ontology 是一个 Python 框架，用于在数据之上搭建语义化、基于图的推理层。按照项目描述，它支持确定性查询生成、更好的上下文检索，以及面向 LLM 与智能体工作流的可解释性。上述能力来自项目自述，尚未见独立评测数据。
cards.whyItMatters: 若该框架的能力如其描述所示，它将为 LLM 应用提供一层结构化的语义中间层，使查询生成不依赖随机采样，并使检索与推理过程更易审查；这对需要可追溯性和稳定输出的智能体场景具有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If its described capabilities hold, the framework provides a structured semantic middleware layer for LLM applications, making query generation less reliant on stochastic sampling and making retrieval and reasoning easier to audit; this is relevant for agent scenarios that demand traceability and stable outputs.
cards.description: 该框架在数据之上构建语义化、基于图的推理层，面向 LLM 与智能体工作流提供确定性查询生成、更优的上下文检索与更强的可解释性；其新意在于把本体与图推理作为 AI 工作流的结构化中间层，有用之处是让检索和查询过程更可控、更易追溯。
cards.limitations: 现有信息仅为 GitHub Trending 条目与项目自述，缺少第三方评测、基准数据与生产案例；框架的实际查询准确性、可解释性收益、对数据规模的适应性以及与现有系统的集成成本均未经证实，因此不宜据此推断其在具体业务中的效果。
cards.title: NVIDIA 发布 Auto Ontology 语义本体框架

keyPointsEn: Four-stage pipeline: event panel construction, LLM behavioral prior elicitation, simulator instantiation, causal discovery and counterfactual analysis.
LLM priors yield a simulated crash rate of 0.176 versus 0.008 under uniform priors, with heavier return tails.
Reducing leverage amplification by one standard deviation lowers the predicted crash rate from 0.176 to 0.136, while directional pressure has a marginal effect.
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a four-stage pipeline that uses an offline large language model to elicit behavioral priors for four agent archetypes conditioned on empirical microstructure anchors, and builds a heterogeneous limit order book simulator. Compared with uninformative uniform priors, LLM priors raise the simulated flash-crash rate from 0.008 to 0.176 and generate heavier return tails, suggesting the approach can improve simulator fidelity in reproducing flash-crash events.
cards.titleEn: LLM Behavioral Priors Improve Bitcoin Flash-Crash Simulation Fidelity
keyPoints: 四阶段流程：事件面板构建、LLM行为先验生成、模拟器实例化、因果发现与反事实分析。
LLM先验模拟闪崩率为0.176，均匀先验为0.008，且LLM先验产生更厚收益尾部。
杠杆放大降低一个标准差使预测闪崩率从0.176降至0.136，方向性压力影响边际。
cards.summaryEn: The research constructs a 100-millisecond BTCUSDT flash-crash event panel and uses a large language model to generate behavioral priors for four trading agent archetypes, driving a heterogeneous limit order book simulation. Across 500 simulation runs, LLM priors produce a crash rate of 0.176 versus 0.008 under uniform priors, with heavier return tails. Counterfactual analysis shows that reducing leverage amplification by one within-sample standard deviation lowers the predicted crash rate to 0.136, while reducing directional pressure has only a marginal effect.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on 66 detected events and 500 simulation runs in a synthetic environment; the validity of LLM priors depends on anchor selection and model version; counterfactual results are simulator-internal predictions, not causal effects in real markets; generalization to other cryptocurrencies or market states remains unverified.
cards.summary: 研究构建了100毫秒粒度的BTCUSDT闪崩事件面板，并用大语言模型生成四类交易代理的行为先验，驱动异构限价订单簿模拟。在500次模拟中，LLM先验产生0.176的闪崩率，远高于均匀先验的0.008，并生成更厚的收益尾部。反事实分析显示，降低杠杆放大一个样本内标准差可将预测闪崩率降至0.136，而降低方向性压力影响甚微。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为缺乏完整订单簿历史数据的场景提供了一种可复现的行为参数获取途径，有助于在受控合成环境中识别闪崩放大机制，对市场微观结构研究和风险监测具有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method offers a reproducible way to obtain behavioral parameters when full order book histories are unavailable, helping identify crash-amplification mechanisms in a controlled synthetic environment and providing reference value for market microstructure research and risk monitoring.
cards.description: 该研究提出一种四阶段流程，利用离线大语言模型在实证微观结构锚点条件下，为四类代理生成行为先验，并构建异构限价订单簿模拟器。与无信息均匀先验相比，LLM先验使模拟闪崩率从0.008升至0.176，且收益尾部更厚，表明该方法可提升模拟器对闪崩事件的复现能力。
cards.limitations: 结论基于66个检测事件和500次模拟的合成环境，LLM先验的有效性依赖锚点选择与模型版本；反事实结果为模拟器内预测，非真实市场因果效应；尚未验证对其他加密货币或市场状态的泛化能力。
cards.originalTitle: Behavioral Prior Elicitation via LLM for Heterogeneous-Agent Bitcoin Flash-Crash Simulation
cards.title: LLM行为先验提升比特币闪崩模拟保真度

keyPointsEn: A structure-exploiting hybrid algorithm uses network upstreamness topology to mitigate the curse of dimensionality in dynamic calibration of cascaded CES parameters.
U.S. multisector time-series calibration indicates that the empirical supply chain is structurally inelastic.
Monte Carlo simulations suggest structural inelasticity converts symmetric microeconomic volatility into heavy-tailed asymmetric risks and significantly lowers expected aggregate productivity.
cards.descriptionEn: A hybrid algorithm exploiting network upstream topology is proposed to address the non-convex inverse optimization problem of dynamically calibrating non-neutral substitution elasticities in a cascaded CES production function. Calibration on U.S. multisector time-series data indicates that the empirical supply chain is structurally inelastic, which endogenously transforms symmetric microeconomic volatility into heavy-tailed asymmetric risks and significantly depresses expecte
cards.titleEn: Dynamically Calibrating Endogenous Transformations in Processing Networks: Structural Inelasticity and Macroeconomic Impedance in U.S. Supply Ch
keyPoints: 提出结构利用型混合算法，借助网络上游拓扑降低级联CES动态校准的维度灾难。
美国多部门时序校准显示经验供应链在结构上缺乏弹性。
蒙特卡洛模拟表明结构无弹性将对称微观波动转化为重尾不对称风险，并显著压低预期总生产率。
cards.summaryEn: The study addresses the difficulty of dynamically calibrating structural parameters of a cascaded CES production function by proposing a structure-exploiting hybrid algorithm that leverages the physical upstreamness topology of the network. Calibrating an economy-wide multisector processing network on U.S. time-series data, the authors report that the empirical supply chain is structurally inelastic; Monte Carlo simulations indicate that this inelasticity acts as a macroeconomic impedance, converting symmetric microeconomic volatility into heavy-tailed asymmetric risks and generating a statistically significant mean sinking effect. These claims about inelasticity and mean sinking are empirical assertions conditional on the model and data, not universal facts requiring no further testing.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries should be explicit: calibration results depend on the cascaded CES specification, the U.S. time-series sample, and the hybrid algorithm used, and cannot be directly extrapolated to other economies or periods; structural inelasticity and the mean sinking effect are model-based simulation and calibration findings rather than causal identification results; the magnitude and significance of heavy-tailed asymmetric risks and productivity depression are subject to parameter uncertainty, data quality, and Monte Carlo design; the study does not constitute investment or policy advice.
cards.summary: 该研究针对级联CES生产函数的结构参数动态校准难题，提出一种利用网络物理上游拓扑的结构利用型混合算法。基于美国时序数据校准全经济多部门处理网络后，作者报告经验供应链具有结构无弹性；蒙特卡洛模拟显示该无弹性充当宏观阻抗，将对称微观波动转化为重尾不对称风险并产生显著的均值下沉效应。上述关于无弹性与均值下沉的结论属于作者基于特定模型和数据的实证主张，而非无需检验的普适事实。
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将理论网络非线性与经验宏观动态衔接起来，为理解生产网络结构参数如何影响波动传导和总生产率提供了可校准的定量工具。若结构无弹性确实普遍存在，则微观层面的对称冲击可能在宏观层面产生不对称且偏下的风险后果，这对评估供应链结构与宏观稳定性之间的关系具有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework bridges theoretical network nonlinearities and empirical macroeconomic dynamics, offering a calibratable quantitative tool to study how production-network structural parameters affect volatility transmission and aggregate productivity. If structural inelasticity is indeed prevalent, symmetric micro-level shocks could generate asymmetric and downward-skewed risk consequences at the macro level, which is relevant for assessing the relationship between supply-chain structure and macroeconomic stability.
cards.description: 提出一种利用网络上游拓扑结构的混合算法，解决级联CES生产函数在时序数据中动态校准非中性替代弹性时的非凸逆优化难题。基于美国多部门时序数据的校准表明，经验供应链呈现结构无弹性，且该特性会将对称微观波动内生转化为重尾不对称风险，并显著拉低预期总生产率。
cards.limitations: 证据边界需明确：校准结果依赖级联CES函数设定、美国时序数据样本及所采用的混合算法，不能直接外推至其他经济体或时期；结构无弹性和均值下沉效应是模型内模拟与校准的统计发现，并非因果识别结论；重尾不对称风险与生产率压低的幅度和显著性受参数不确定性、数据质量及蒙特卡洛设计影响；该研究不构成投资或政策建议。
cards.originalTitle: Computing Endogenous Transformations in Processing Networks: A Dynamic Calibration Approach
cards.title: 动态校准处理网络内生转换：美国供应链的结构无弹性与宏观阻抗

keyPointsEn: The repository presents Garry Tan's Claude Code setup with 23 opinionated tools.
Tools are grouped into six roles: CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, doc engineer and QA.
It is positioned as a ready-made configuration rather than a general framework.
cards.descriptionEn: The repository packages Garry Tan's Claude Code configuration into 23 opinionated tools that act as CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, doc engineer and QA. Its novelty is organizing AI coding work by role rather than scattered prompts, making it a reference for teams exploring AI-assisted development workflows and multi-role collaboration.
cards.titleEn: gstack Ships 23 Role-Based Tools for Claude Code
keyPoints: 仓库自述提供 Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置，含 23 个有明确取向的工具。
工具按 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师与 QA 六类角色划分。
定位是可照用的现成配置，而非通用框架。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the garrytan/gstack repository on GitHub offers Garry Tan's Claude Code setup, described as 23 opinionated tools spanning six development roles. The author's framing presents this as a ready-to-use configuration. Actual effectiveness needs independent verification; the source provides no evaluation data.
cards.limitationsEn: Only the repository self-description and source summary are available; official docs, maintenance activity, license and compatible versions are unknown. The 23 tools' effectiveness, applicable scenarios and failure boundaries lack benchmarks or user feedback, so no general benefit can be inferred.
cards.summary: 事实：GitHub 上出现 garrytan/gstack 仓库，按来源描述提供 Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置，包含 23 个有明确取向的工具，覆盖六个研发角色。作者观点倾向是把这套配置视为可直接照用的方案。其实际效果需独立验证，来源未给出评测数据。
cards.whyItMatters: AI 辅助编码正从单点提示走向多角色、流程化配置。若角色化工具确能覆盖从设计到 QA 的环节，团队可参考其分工方式组织自有工作流；但价值取决于实际可用性与适配成本。
cards.whyItMattersEn: AI-assisted coding is shifting from isolated prompts toward multi-role, process-oriented setups. If these role tools do cover stages from design to QA, teams can borrow the division of labor for their own workflows; value depends on real usability and adaptation cost.
cards.description: 该仓库把 Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置整理成 23 个有明确取向的工具，分别充当 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师与 QA。其新意在于以角色分工而非零散提示词来组织 AI 编码工作流，便于关注 AI 辅助研发流程的团队参考和多角色协作复用。
